summary_interpretation: Denmark transfer should be reported as low-recall hard transfer under one-class target labels, not as evidence for or against broad structural generalization.
Philippines is a hard transfer target that becomes recoverable with small target supervision; Week7 alone does not establish robust unsupervised transfer.
Ontario should be used only as licensed-consistency/anomaly-style boundary evidence, not as a standard transfer success.
France has high transfer performance, but Week8 E5 shows substantial lexical/ccTLD assistance; it is not pure structural transfer evidence.
